name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land
description: Financial assistance disbursed in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2000 directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of beneficiary farmers.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
benefit: Low interest institutional loan at 4% p.a.
eligibility: Farmers, sharecroppers, tenant farmers, and SHGs
description: Flexible, hassle-free credit facility up to ₹3,00,000 to meet crop production expenses, post-harvest costs, and maintenance of farm assets.

name: FPO Formation & Promotion Scheme
benefit: Up to ₹18 Lakh matching equity grant & support
eligibility: Groups of 300+ farmers in plains / 100+ in hilly regions
description: Empowering farmer producer organizations with bulk purchasing discounts on inputs, modern aggregation infrastructure, and institutional market access.
